Path 1, policyGOALS §2.1

Kyverno

Policy as Kubernetes YAML, for what in-tree CEL can't express.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF policy engine that validates, mutates, generates and cleans up resources, with policy reports and a CLI that runs the same policies in CI.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Versus OPA Gatekeeper: policies in YAML rather than Rego, plus generation and mutation. It now authors CEL-based policies too, riding the in-tree direction instead of competing with it.

WHERE WE STAND

Our policy layer: CI shift-left, change-window gating against a projected CRD, and reports.

Kyverno maintainer track; "Signed, Sealed, Denied" (AT&T), KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT

Kyverno: Policy as Kubernetes YAML, for what in-tree CEL can't express. Where we stand: Our policy layer: CI shift-left, change-window gating against a projected CRD, and reports. The change-window CRD keeps the admission path from depending on the ITSM system being up.
